pressure_channel_validity: channel exists in schema-v6 hydraulic data, length equals valid time length, and contains at least one finite numeric value; Bronze never supplies pressure or QC validity
positive_gate: resolved explicit or unique structural family, both disclosure thresholds, and at least one structurally valid commanded or achieved pressure record
migration: deep-copy schema-v6 record and add only source provenance derived from aligned Bronze; never call normalize_shot for historical fields
schema_v6_authority: Every pre-existing normalized value is authoritative and must be preserved exactly, including context.profile_present and context.n_tags.
decision: Stage 2 executes only if at least one disclosure-qualified recovered family has a valid schema-v6 commanded or achieved pressure channel; otherwise select OBS-PANNUSCH-FRACTION-WINDOW-001 and close the Visualizer route.
no_rule_tuning: No recovery or semantic rule changed after Attempt-1 corpus counts were observed.
